name: Sitcom: Location Interior
description: Image preset for a location interior in the Sitcom look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an interior. List the room's purpose, three props that say who uses it, and the light source from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: interior view of the location from a doorway or corner, key furniture and props in place, light source visible, room for characters to stand, multi-camera sitcom still, bright even studio lighting, three-wall standing set dressed with lived-in detail, medium shot at eye level, high-key lighting with soft shadows, warm saturated colour, everything in focus
negative_prompt: dark moody lighting, cinematic shallow focus, horror, gritty grain, text, watermark
